title: SDAD：面向AI原生软件开发生命周期的规范驱动智能体开发
summary: 本文正式提出规范驱动智能体开发（SDAD），将前期规范化与高速实现相结合，涵盖意图捕获、机器可读规范、智能体综合及独立多智能体验证。论文回顾了瀑布与敏捷的演变，引入AI代码作为第四生产范式，并扩展至团队角色转变、量化治理及分阶段迁移蓝图，强调智能体速度不消除工程纪律，而是将纪律上移至规范精度与可审计溯源。
summary_en: This paper formalizes Spec-Driven Agentic Development (SDAD), combining disciplined upfront formalization with high-velocity implementation, covering intent capture, machine-readable specs, agentic synthesis, and independent multi-agent verification. It revisits Waterfall vs Agile, introduces AI-code as a fourth paradigm, and extends to role metamorphosis, quantitative governance, and staged migration, arguing agentic speed relocates discipline upstream.
